items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution this cycle. Retain existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution and cost reconciliation, legal evidence, security evidence, affiliate validation, and parked-site readiness work. No revenue, ROI, margin, payback, conversion lift, or causal-lift claims are supported.
